test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions I, II, III and IV. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem at variance from commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some pamphlets are copies.

2. All copies are readers.

3. All readers are scrolls.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pamphlets are scrolls.

II. All copies are scrolls.

III. Some readers are copies.

IV. Some scrolls are pamphlets.

options.text: Only conclusions II, III and IV follow.
Only conclusions II and IV follow.
Only conclusions I, III and IV follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
__Statements:__

1. Some pamphlets are copies.

2. All copies are readers.

3. All readers are scrolls.

__**Venn diagram:**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4340de2ea9ecebb3113e47d4ce0b39c1deee54282244f223d058abebc691cc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pamphlets are scrolls→ Does not follow → Since some pamphlets are copies when means only some pamphlets can be scrolls and the same can be seen in the Venn diagram thus the conclusion does not follow.

II. All copies are scrolls→ Follow → We have 'all copies are readers' & 'all readers are scrolls' then it is correct to conclude that all copies are scrolls therefore the conclusion follows. 

III. Some readers are copies→ Follow → From the statements, 'all copies are readers' which means there have to be some part of readers who are copies and it is clearly visible in the Venn diagram therefore the conclusion follows.

IV. Some scrolls are pamphlets→ Follow → Here 'all copies are readers' & 'all readers are scrolls' which implies all copies are scrolls, also 'some copies are pamphlets' similarly some scrolls are pamphlets therefore the conclusion follows.

So **only conclusions II, III & IV follows.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 1)**
